fact: At its meeting of 3 June 2024 the ANPDP examined 36 declaration and authorisation forms from named controllers, after 91 forms were received at its single window on 2-6 June 2024 and 13 were accepted and 78 held for errors.
title: اجتماع 11 جوان 2024
